description: This file defines external variables, data structures, and function prototypes related to the 'fsmonitor' extension in version control system index management. It provides interfaces for reading, writing, adding, removing, tweaking, and refreshing the fsmonitor extension within the index.

methods.name: read_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Reads the fsmonitor extension data from the index and restores the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state if configured.

methods.name: fill_fsmonitor_bitmap
methods.description: Populates the fsmonitor's dirty ewah bits with their current state from the index before it is split during writing.

methods.name: write_fsmonitor_extension
methods.description: Writes the CE_FSMONITOR_VALID state into the index extension based on the current dirty ewah bits.

methods.name: add_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adds the fsmonitor extension to the index.

methods.name: remove_fsmonitor
methods.description: Removes the fsmonitor extension from the index.

methods.name: tweak_fsmonitor
methods.description: Adjusts the presence of the fsmonitor extension based on current configuration settings.

methods.name: refresh_fsmonitor
methods.description: Runs the fsmonitor integration script, updates the index state, and invalidates related cache structures; optimized for first-time execution.

methods.name: fsmonitor_is_trivial_response
methods.description: Determines whether the given response from the fsmonitor is trivial, indicating no significant changes.
